'''Anoat oats''' were an edible [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Cereal/Legends|cereal]] which could be eaten by members of the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] species. The oats were served with two strips of [[Nuna bacon]] at the Besalisk [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster's]] [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] [[district]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The dish cost 4.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was the second breakfast special of the [[Pantoran Plate Specials|Pantoran plate special]], a series of dishes available on the diner's menu. It was served at Dex's<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> It shared its name with [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]], a habitable planet in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Anoat oats were first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="DaD" />
